grants.statement: SELECT grantee, catalog_name, privilege_type FROM cs4603.information_schema.catalog_privileges WHERE grantee = '53f956da-ff9f-4f38-a9f9-cf8f494a04b0'
SELECT grantee, catalog_name, schema_name, privilege_type FROM cs4603.information_schema.schema_privileges WHERE grantee = '53f956da-ff9f-4f38-a9f9-cf8f494a04b0' AND schema_name = 'pa4'

SELECT grantee, table_catalog, table_schema, table_name, privilege_type FROM cs4603.information_schema.table_privileges WHERE grantee = '53f956da-ff9f-4f38-a9f9-cf8f494a04b0' AND table_schema = 'pa4' AND table_name LIKE 'meridian_%' ORDER BY table_name
